talking_points: ChatGPT's search volume has reportedly reached a fifth of Google's, and OpenAI is leaning into ads as its monetisation plan ahead of a possible IPO.
Meta is borrowing up to $25bn just days after its credit outlook was cut, showing how even cash-rich tech giants are financing the AI build-out with debt.
Anthropic's Nasdaq filing under ticker ANT could become the defining 'pure-play AI' IPO and a benchmark for every private AI valuation.
